## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run lint` passes (typecheck + cargo fmt + clippy `-D warnings`)
- [ ] `bun run test` passes (Vitest)
- [ ] `bun run test:rust` passes (Rust sidecar)
- [ ] No telemetry/analytics added; any network use is opt-in and BYOK
- [ ] No dead UI (buttons/shortcuts that don't work)
- [ ] Behavior changes are covered by a test
